info.syllabusName: Thực hành chuyên môn 3 (Practice 3: Market Research)
info.description: This course provides students practical knowledge related to implement marketing research program in reality. Moreover, this course is designed to fill the gap between knowledge and practice, as well as provides necessary skills to define research questions, prepare research literature foundation, and other issues surrounding data management, project’s technical determinants and even ethical issue. Beside providing acknowledgement about marketing research, this course also focuses on forming student’s ability to make plan and implement marketing research for individual and organization in reality.
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Apply collecting data tools, forming effective questionaires to collect data; organizing collecting data process after studying main definitions related to marketing research, fundamental principles in forming a marketing research strategy.

Analyse realistic problems in implementing a primary research including data, security and ethical management using different philosophies of how to approach market research with different methodologies; understand core definitions, meaning, roles and applicating fields of marketing research;
Evaluate research results to use and apply in firm’s business activities
Create a report or a marketing research project for a specific business activity and present to managers
